ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (25) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Благо» (blago) is 'the good' or 'a good' throughout, where the website draft had 'blessing'; Amiel's «овладение» (ovladenie) is 'taking possession' (of heavenly joy, of God through love). The paired phrases «ни на чем не основанное» (ni na chem ne osnovannoe, 'founded on nothing') and «ничем не нарушаемое» (nichem ne narushaemoe, 'disturbed by nothing') keep their parallel.
